title: 第11章 我还想叫李逍遥呢第12章 寂灭之环
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
费了一番功夫，安东总算将鳞岩蜥身上有价值的材料分解采集完毕，尽数放入纳物符里。
随后他又马不停蹄地开始下一轮狩猎。
结果不出他所料，寒渊剑确实是鳞岩蜥的克星。
剑招蕴含的极寒之气能让鳞岩蜥血液凝滞、脏器衰竭，动作明显变得迟缓僵硬，支撑不了多久便被安东斩于剑下。
狩猎效率一下子提高了一大截。
尽管期间好几次停下来运转功法恢复灵气，但等到天际尽头泛起金红时，安东收集的蜥肉、鳞皮和蜥血也已经堆满了一整张纳物符。
见天色不早，安东没再继续狩猎，而是找了处三面都有巨岩遮挡的背风之地，准备在这里过夜。
他盘膝坐下，从纳物符中取出备好的木柴堆成篝火，屈指一弹，一缕火属灵气自指尖激射而出，嗤的一声轻响，干燥的木头瞬间燃起橙红的火焰。
火光摇曳，在岩壁上投下拉长的影子。
安东取出一块鳞岩蜥的后腿肉，用削好的树枝串上，架在火焰上方炙烤。
肉块在热力下滋滋作响，油脂滴落，激起阵阵火星，他不时撒上盐末和香料。
这些调料在纳物符中备了不少，毕竟血食炼体需要大量进食，没点滋味可难以下咽。
好不容易等肉烤至外焦里嫩，他立刻大口啃咬，不一会整块后腿肉便进了肚子。
感受到胃部传来的充实感，安东没有耽搁，立刻开始运转《归墟吞海功》。
这是大道玉简中记载的最顶尖的血食炼体法门。
取“鲸吞万物，归于墟海“之意，于丹田中开辟无形漩涡，将吞入的灵兽血肉连皮带骨一同绞碎、熔炼、提纯，化为最精纯的气血精华反哺肉身。
随着功法运转，安东腹部顿时传出低沉的轰鸣声，仿佛远古巨兽在海底沉睡时的呼吸。
他能清晰地感觉到，胃囊里的兽肉被迅速分解成最细微的颗粒，化作一缕缕温热的气血精华，如涓涓细流涌向四肢百骸。
一边运转功法消化食物，安东一边继续烤肉。
兽肉烤好的第一时间就被立刻吃掉，化作功法持续运转的养料。

直到一个多小时后，一整头鳞岩蜥的肉都被消化殆尽，安东的身体终于传来隐隐的饱胀感，如同盛满水的陶罐，再倾倒便会溢出。
“到极限了。”
安东停下进食，闭目感应体内变化。
气血充盈，经脉鼓胀，丹田中的太初灵气似乎都比往日活跃了三分。
他试着运转《太初归藏诀》，发现吐纳炼化的效率果然有所提升。
虽然不是很明显，却真实存在。
“如果每天都用归墟吞海功炼化一头鳞岩蜥......”
安东在心中默默推算，随后露出欣喜的笑容。
照这个进度，两年半左右他就能炼化出一口太初灵气。
修炼速度比之前又提高了一半不止。
血食炼体之法，果然进益神速。
修仙之路，最耗的便是水磨工夫，任何能缩短时间的手段都弥足珍贵。
一番折腾下来，天色已经快要彻底暗下去。
远处的峰峦化作漆黑的剪影，只有天边还残留着最后一抹暗红。
安东往篝火里添了几根木柴，正打算入定修炼，猛不丁听到远处传来一阵脚步声。
“前面那地方看起来不错，我们今晚就在那里过夜好了。”
“咦，有火光，那里有人了。”
content_en:
After a lot of effort, Anton finally decomposed and collected the valuable materials from the scaled rock lizard and put them all into the storage talisman.
Then he started the next round of hunting without stopping.
As he expected, Han Yuan Sword was indeed the nemesis of the Scaled Rock Lizard.
The extremely cold energy contained in the sword moves can cause the scaled rock lizard's blood to stagnate, its organs to fail, and its movements to become obviously slow and stiff. It cannot hold on for long before it is killed by Anton's sword.
The hunting efficiency suddenly improved a lot.
Even though he stopped several times to run the technique to restore his spiritual energy, by the time the sky turned golden and red, the lizard meat, scales and blood collected by Anton had already filled an entire talisman.
Seeing that it was getting late, Anton did not continue hunting. Instead, he found a leeward place covered by huge rocks on three sides and prepared to spend the night here.
He sat down cross-legged, took out the prepared firewood from the storage talisman and piled it into a bonfire. He flicked his fingers, and a wisp of fire spiritual energy shot out from his fingertips. With a soft hiss, the dry wood instantly ignited with orange-red flames.
The firelight flickered, casting long shadows on the rock wall.
Anton took out a piece of scaly rock lizard hind leg meat, skewered it with a shaved branch, and grilled it over a flame.
The meat sizzled under the heat, the grease dripped, sparking sparks. He sprinkled it with salt and spices from time to time.
A lot of these condiments are prepared in the Nawu Talisman. After all, blood food and body training require a lot of food, and it will be difficult to swallow without some flavor.
After finally waiting for the meat to be roasted until it was charred on the outside and tender on the inside, he immediately took a big bite and soon the whole piece of hind leg meat was in his stomach.
Feeling the feeling of fullness coming from his stomach, Anton didn't waste any time and immediately started to operate the "Guixu Swallowing Sea Technique".
This is the most advanced blood-eating body refining method recorded in the Dao Jade Slips.
Taking the meaning of "a whale swallows all things and returns them to the sea of ​​ruins", an invisible whirlpool is created in the Dantian to mince, smelt and purify the swallowed spirit animal flesh and blood together with the skin and bones, turning it into the purest essence of Qi and blood to feed back to the physical body.
As the technique was running, a low roar suddenly came from Anton's abdomen, like the breathing of an ancient giant beast sleeping on the bottom of the sea.
He could clearly feel that the animal meat in the stomach pouch was quickly broken down into the tiniest particles, turning into wisps of warm qi and blood essence, flowing to the limbs and bones like a trickle.
While running the exercises to digest the food, Anton continued to barbecue.
The animal meat is eaten as soon as it is roasted and turned into nourishment for the continuous operation of the technique.
It wasn't until more than an hour later that the entire scaly rock lizard's meat had been digested, and Anton's body finally felt a faint feeling of fullness, like a clay pot filled with water that would overflow if he tipped it over again.
"It's reached its limit."
Anton stopped eating and closed his eyes to sense the changes in his body.
The energy and blood are full, the meridians are bulging, and the Taichu spiritual energy in the Dantian seems to be three points more active than before.
He tried to run the "Taichu Guizang Jue" and found that the efficiency of breathing and refining had indeed improved.
Although it's not obvious, it's real.
"If you use the Gui Xu Swallowing Sea Kung Fu to refine a scaled rock lizard every day..."
Anton calculated silently in his mind, and then smiled happily.
According to this progress, he will be able to refine a breath of Taichu spiritual energy in about two and a half years.
The cultivation speed has increased by more than half compared to before.
The method of refining the body by eating blood really makes rapid progress.
The most time-consuming thing on the road to cultivating immortality is time, and any means that can shorten the time are extremely valuable.
After all the hard work, the sky was almost completely dark.
The distant peaks turned into dark silhouettes, with only the last touch of dark red remaining on the horizon.
Anton added a few pieces of firewood to the campfire and was about to enter meditation practice when he suddenly heard footsteps in the distance.
"The place in front looks nice. Let's spend the night there tonight."
"Hey, there's fire, there's someone there."
